title: Amazon API Gateway HTTP API to AWS Lambda to RDS Proxy
description: Create an HTTP API endpoint that calls a Lambda function to RDS Proxy.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Sets up an API Gateway HTTP API endpoint with an AWS Lambda function as an integration. The Lambda function integrates with RDS Proxy to query the RDS Aurora (MySQL) relational database.

testing.headline: Testing
text: See testing in the README.md file in the repo
